title: microstachys glandulosa
intro: Microstachys glandulosa, commonly known as "Himalayan Sandalwood" or "East Indian Sandalwood", is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is a native plant to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Microstachys glandulosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and have antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments such as bronchitis and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include santalols, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
